title: Reverse Vowels of a String
goal: Solve Reverse Vowels of a String: Two pointers from both ends: advance each pointer until it lands on a vowel, then swap.
strategy: Two pointers from both ends: advance each pointer until it lands on a vowel, then swap.
edgeCases: Only vowels exchange positions; consonants remain at their original indices, and letter case remains part of each character.
